sloka: श्रावयिष्यामि सर्वाणि मधुरां प्रब्रुवन् गिरम् ।श्रद्धास्यति यथा हीयं तथा सर्वं समादधे ।। ५.३०.४३।।।।
transliteration: śrāvayiṣyāmi sarvāṇi madhurāṁ prabruvan giram ।śraddhāsyati yathā hīyaṁ tathā sarvaṁ samādadhe ।। 5.30.43।।।।

translations.english: "I shall present in auspicious words the esteemed Rama of Ikshvaku family who is a knower of self and make her listen to everything in such a sweet manner that she will trust me.
